forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M3A32XTTF1JWYSA9GPDZP3KQ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8c80
+title: 'Web: create the WebIntegrationTests package with keyless live tests'
+---
+## What
+Add the live test package that searches the real web and fetches real pages, with no model. Design: `web.md` § "Testing / Level 2" (why a separate package, the assertion rule, the suite table).
+
+- Create `WebIntegrationTests/Package.swift`, modelled on `IntegrationTests/Package.swift`: `platforms: [.macOS("27.0")]`, `.package(path: "..")`, and the SwiftSoup dependency with the same URL and requirement as the root `Package.swift`. One test target `FoundationModelsMultitoolWebIntegrationTests` that links only `FoundationModelsMultitool` (no MLX, no Router live wiring). A doc comment states that the package reads the environment on purpose, because the keyed tests (next task) test that feature.
+- Create these suites under `WebIntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolWebIntegrationTests/`, each `.serialized` with `.timeLimit(.minutes(1))`:
+  - `BraveHTMLLiveTests`: `[.braveHTML]` only; query `swift programming language` gives at least 3 hits, each `https`, and a host that is `swift.org` or ends in `.swift.org`; `site: "developer.apple.com"` gives hosts that end in `apple.com`.
+  - `DuckDuckGoHTMLLiveTests`: the same two tests with `[.duckDuckGoHTML]`.
+  - `KeylessChainLiveTests`: `.keyless` gives hits from one of the two keyless providers.
+  - `FetchLiveTests`: `https://example.com` (title `Example Domain`); `http://github.com` (final URL starts with `https://github.com`); the Wikipedia Swift page with `maxCharacters: 2000` (a `nextOffset`, and a second window with no second download); `https://api.github.com/zen` (`text/plain`); a PDF URL (the binary correction).
+  - `GuardLiveTests`: `http://localtest.me/` (the correction names the loopback address); `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` (a correction).
+  - `WebRunCodeLiveTests`: a real `MultiTool` with `.withWeb(configuration: .keyless)` runs the snippet of `web.md` § "Goal" and returns 1 to 3 pages with titles and content.
+- No test retries. A test asserts only the stable facts above.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift build --package-path WebIntegrationTests --build-tests` succeeds.
+- [ ] `swift test --package-path WebIntegrationTests --no-parallel` passes on a machine with network access.
+- [ ] The root `swift test` does not compile or run any of these suites.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The suites above.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path WebIntegrationTests --no-parallel`. All pass.
+- [ ] Run `swift test` at the root. All pass, and no web live suite runs.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #web
\ No newline at end of file
